summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Antares Strategic Credit Fund, a business development company, reporting a regular monthly distribution of $0.1910 per share and providing a routine monthly NAV and portfolio update. The registrant offers its common shares continuously via a private placement and received $3.4 million in subscriptions during May 2026. The filing does not describe a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, or delisting. There is no board recommendation, advisor, premium, implied value, or structural changes. The entire disclosure is a standard periodic update for an ongoing share offering and a regular distribution declared for shareholders of record as of May 28, 2026. No risk-arb angle or regulatory clock applies.
